factors.name: Independently owned live website
factors.note: Google Maps lists thtairsolutions.com, but the domain returns NXDOMAIN from Google DNS and a 404 from Verisign's .com RDAP (not registered). Chrome shows an error page. Google search knowledge panel shows 'Add website'. A Google search for "THT Air Solutions" returns Facebook, Yelp, Nextdoor and directories, no owned site. Per SCHEMA, category = 0.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: Listing has address, hours, category, photos, videos tab, 'Identifies as women-owned', Products (seasonal specials) and Updates. Docked because the website field points to a dead domain.

factors.name: NAP consistency
factors.note: Address matches everywhere. Phone: Google shows (877) 670-1934; Yelp, Nextdoor, BBB, MapQuest and Yahoo Local all show (214) 575-2323.

factors.name: Appears for primary local query
factors.note: Google Maps search 'ac repair prosper tx' on 2026-11-02 (map centered on Prosper): THT was the first non-sponsored result, below two ads (A#1 Air, JUPITAIR HVAC). It was the only result in the list without a Website button. Screenshot saved. Rank varies by searcher location.

factors.name: Rating

factors.name: Recency

factors.name: Owner responses
